proposed.explanation: Overstates MRA reach—mutual recognition is not elimination; national procedures remain. Creates false carve-out—national requirements apply equally to all foreign architects, ASEAN or not. Grants false exemption—ASEAN status facilitates, not exempts, from national procedures. The MRA recognizes mutual equivalency of qualifications but does not eliminate national licensing requirements; ASEAN professionals must still comply with host country procedures. The ASEAN MRA harmonizes standards but does not replace national licensing—ASEAN Architects still must comply with host country procedures.
